about_the_game:
About This Game

Hivaneph – The Legend of Elles is an action game with RPG elements for Windows, focusing on narrative, layered exploration, and memorable, charismatic characters.

Cecil, a 14-year-old with a hearing impairment, possesses a unique ability he calls the "Adventure's Sense."

After extensive research, Cecil discovered a possible new origin for our universe—one influenced by other worlds and species—centered around a magical energy that flows through all living beings. Cecil then awakens this mysterious energy, known as Naii, and embarks on the greatest adventure of his life.

Exploration: Venture through a semi-open world that is rich both horizontally and vertically. Each character has a unique exploration ability—a distinct way of seeing the world that allows them to find items, solve puzzles, and uncover new stories.

Dynamic, Real-Time Combat: The battles are packed with energy and skill, enabling every player to adapt the gameplay to their own style with each new encounter.

Party-Based Gameplay: Assemble a squad of up to four characters, each with unique and diverse abilities. You can control one of them and switch between characters at any time.

Narrative Focus: Storytelling is a cornerstone of the Hivaneph universe. Each character faces personal dilemmas and has their own reasons to fight. These challenges continually test the characters—like Cecil, who constantly confronts doubt and fear, drawing strength from his hearing impairment.

Other storylines also delve into contemporary themes such as combating racism and LGBT-phobia, dealing with grief, abusive relationships, and mental health.

Skill Upgrades: Each character features a skill tree based on the principles of their elemental affinity, which can be enhanced as the player progresses through the story.

Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen 5 1600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 / Intel Arc A380
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
